identity_and_lifecycle.name: client_id
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Alphanumeric synthetic client identifier; join metric tables on this column.

identity_and_lifecycle.name: name
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Full name of the user for identification

identity_and_lifecycle.name: email
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Primary email address of the user

identity_and_lifecycle.name: first_trade_date
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Date of the user's first recorded trade

identity_and_lifecycle.name: days_since_first_trade
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Number of days since the user's first trade (cohort analysis)

identity_and_lifecycle.name: last_calculated_at
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Timestamp when this metric row was last updated

identity_and_lifecycle.name: days_since_last_seen
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Number of days since the user was last active (churn risk indicator)

identity_and_lifecycle.name: primary_platform_30d
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Device platform with most events in last 30 days (web/ios/android)

identity_and_lifecycle.name: is_multi_platform_user_30d
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Flag (1/0) if user was active on multiple platforms in last 30 days

identity_and_lifecycle.name: unique_ip_count_30d
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Number of unique IP addresses used in last 30 days

identity_and_lifecycle.name: latest_app_version_used
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Most recent app version recorded on user's events

identity_and_lifecycle.name: signup_date
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Date when user's account was first created

identity_and_lifecycle.name: account_age_days
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Total days user has been registered on platform

identity_and_lifecycle.name: activation_status
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Whether user has made at least one deposit (Activated/Not Activated)

identity_and_lifecycle.name: active_days_30d
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Number of unique days user was active in last 30 days

identity_and_lifecycle.name: avg_time_since_last_activity_per_login
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Average gap in days between consecutive logins

identity_and_lifecycle.name: distinct_login_ids_90d
identity_and_lifecycle.description: Number of unique login_id values in last 90 days

trading_frequency.name: client_id
trading_frequency.description: Alphanumeric synthetic client identifier; join metric tables on this column.

trading_frequency.name: trade_count_1d
trading_frequency.description: Total trades executed in last 24 hours

trading_frequency.name: trade_count_7d
trading_frequency.description: Total trades executed in last 7 days

trading_frequency.name: trade_count_30d
trading_frequency.description: Total trades executed in last 30 days (key engagement metric)

trading_frequency.name: trade_count_90d
trading_frequency.description: Total trades executed in last 90 days

trading_frequency.name: trade_count_360d
trading_frequency.description: Total trades executed in last 360 days

trading_frequency.name: active_trading_days_90d
trading_frequency.description: Number of unique days user placed trades in last 90 days

trading_frequency.name: trades_per_active_day_90d
trading_frequency.description: Average trades per active trading day

trading_frequency.name: avg_activity_cluster_duration_minutes_30d
trading_frequency.description: Average duration of continuous activity sessions in minutes

trading_frequency.name: avg_http_requests_per_session_30d
trading_frequency.description: Average API requests per activity session

trading_frequency.name: cluster_bounce_rate_30d
trading_frequency.description: Percentage of sessions with ≤3 events (bounce indicator) Stored as a fraction (0–1); multiply by 100 for percentage display.

trading_frequency.name: weekend_cluster_count_30d
trading_frequency.description: Number of activity sessions initiated on weekends

trading_frequency.name: primary_activity_hour
trading_frequency.description: Hour of day (0-23) with highest platform events

trading_frequency.name: is_morning_active_flag
trading_frequency.description: Flag (1/0) if >50% of events occur before noon

trading_frequency.name: weekday_concentration_score_90d
trading_frequency.description: Herfindahl index of trade counts by weekday (higher means more concentrated).

trading_frequency.name: trade_volume_consistency_score_90d
trading_frequency.description: Score (0-1) measuring consistency of daily trading volume

trading_frequency.name: max_trades_per_second_90d
trading_frequency.description: Maximum trades executed in any single second

trading_frequency.name: primary_trade_day_90d
trading_frequency.description: Day of week with highest number of trades

trading_frequency.name: trade_count_by_day_of_week_variance_90d
trading_frequency.description: Population standard deviation of trade counts across observed weekdays.

trading_frequency.name: activity_momentum_score
trading_frequency.description: Score indicating if trading activity is accelerating (>1) or decelerating (<1)

financial_volume.name: client_id
financial_volume.description: Alphanumeric synthetic client identifier; join metric tables on this column.

financial_volume.name: total_volume_1d
financial_volume.description: Total notional value of trades in last 24 hours

financial_volume.name: total_volume_7d
financial_volume.description: Total notional value of trades in last 7 days

financial_volume.name: total_volume_30d
financial_volume.description: Total notional value of trades in last 30 days (primary user value indicator)

financial_volume.name: total_volume_90d
financial_volume.description: Total notional value of trades in last 90 days

financial_volume.name: avg_trade_size_90d
financial_volume.description: Average notional value per trade (distinguishes HFT vs large traders)

financial_volume.name: total_deposit_amount_all_time
financial_volume.description: Cumulative total amount deposited (core CLV metric)

financial_volume.name: net_deposit_flow_90d
financial_volume.description: Net cash flow (Deposits - Withdrawals) in last 90 days

financial_volume.name: net_deposit_value_all_time
financial_volume.description: User's total net financial contribution over lifetime

financial_volume.name: deposit_frequency_90d
financial_volume.description: Number of distinct deposit events in last 90 days

financial_volume.name: avg_margin_utilization_pct_30d
financial_volume.description: Mean blocked margin / available capital fraction (0–1), not percentage points.

financial_volume.name: days_since_first_withdrawal
financial_volume.description: Days since user made first withdrawal (success/trust indicator)

behavioral_style.name: client_id
behavioral_style.description: Alphanumeric synthetic client identifier; join metric tables on this column.

behavioral_style.name: avg_holding_duration_all_time
behavioral_style.description: Mean matched-position holding duration in seconds.

behavioral_style.name: order_cancellation_rate_30d
behavioral_style.description: Percentage of orders cancelled (indecision/bot indicator) Stored as a fraction (0–1); multiply by 100 for percentage display.

behavioral_style.name: order_modification_rate_30d
behavioral_style.description: Percentage of orders modified Stored as a fraction (0–1); multiply by 100 for percentage display.

behavioral_style.name: buy_to_sell_ratio_30d
behavioral_style.description: Ratio of buy to sell volume (accumulating vs distributing bias)

behavioral_style.name: distinct_symbols_traded_90d
behavioral_style.description: Number of unique assets traded (portfolio diversification measure)

behavioral_style.name: win_rate_90d
behavioral_style.description: Fraction (0–1) of trading days with positive realized P&L during the last 90 days.

behavioral_style.name: profit_factor_90d
behavioral_style.description: Ratio of gross profits to gross losses (>1 indicates profitability)

behavioral_style.name: platform_logins_30d
behavioral_style.description: Number of unique login sessions (platform engagement)

behavioral_style.name: funds_check_count_30d
behavioral_style.description: Times user checked account balance/margin information

behavioral_style.name: portfolio_click_count_30d
behavioral_style.description: Times user clicked Portfolio navigation

behavioral_style.name: orders_page_view_count_30d
behavioral_style.description: Times user viewed Orders page

behavioral_style.name: dashboard_pins_view_count_30d
behavioral_style.description: Times main dashboard loaded pinned/watchlisted items

behavioral_style.name: order_to_trade_ratio_30d
behavioral_style.description: Ratio of orders placed to trades executed

behavioral_style.name: is_options_trader_flag
behavioral_style.description: Flag (1/0) if user has ever traded options contracts

behavioral_style.name: order_modification_pre_execution_rate_30d
behavioral_style.description: Percentage of orders modified before execution Stored as a fraction (0–1); multiply by 100 for percentage display.

behavioral_style.name: stop_loss_usage_rate_90d
behavioral_style.description: Percentage of orders that were triggered/stop-loss type Stored as a fraction (0–1); multiply by 100 for percentage display.

behavioral_style.name: intraday_vs_delivery_ratio_90d
behavioral_style.description: Ratio of intraday to delivery trades

behavioral_style.name: order_chasing_rate_30d
behavioral_style.description: Percentage of modified orders with less favorable prices (urgency indicator) Stored as a fraction (0–1); multiply by 100 for percentage display.

behavioral_style.name: primary_order_type
behavioral_style.description: Most common order type across all orders (MARKET, LIMIT or STOP).

behavioral_style.name: median_time_between_trades_90d
behavioral_style.description: Median duration in minutes between consecutive trades

behavioral_style.name: is_holding_overnight_positions_flag
behavioral_style.description: Whether any matched position was held for at least 24 hours; a historical holding behavior flag.

risk_profile.name: client_id
risk_profile.description: Alphanumeric synthetic client identifier; join metric tables on this column.

risk_profile.name: pnl_1d
risk_profile.description: Profit/loss from trading in last 24 hours

risk_profile.name: pnl_7d
risk_profile.description: Profit/loss from trading in last 7 days

risk_profile.name: pnl_30d
risk_profile.description: Profit/loss from trading in last 30 days

risk_profile.name: pnl_90d
risk_profile.description: Profit/loss from trading in last 90 days

risk_profile.name: pnl_360d
risk_profile.description: Profit/loss from trading in last 360 days

risk_profile.name: total_pnl_90d
risk_profile.description: Realized profit/loss on matched closed fills during the last 90 days, in INR; identical to pnl_90d.

risk_profile.name: user_rank_by_pnl_90d
risk_profile.description: User's absolute rank based on total_pnl_90d vs all traders

risk_profile.name: pnl_percentile_90d
risk_profile.description: Fraction (0–1) from percent_rank of realized 90-day P&L, across all clients.

risk_profile.name: max_single_day_loss_90d
risk_profile.description: Magnitude of worst daily realized loss (nonnegative INR; zero when no losses).

risk_profile.name: pnl_volatility_90d
risk_profile.description: Standard deviation of daily P&L (risk volatility measure)

risk_profile.name: large_loss_day_count_90d
risk_profile.description: Number of days with P&L below -₹10,000 threshold

risk_profile.name: max_pnl_drawdown_90d
risk_profile.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline in cumulative P&L

risk_profile.name: post_large_loss_behavior_change_flag
risk_profile.description: Flag (1/0) for revenge trading behavior after large losses

risk_profile.name: is_concentrated_trader_flag
risk_profile.description: Flag (1/0) if >80% of volume from single instrument (high-risk concentration)

risk_profile.name: trade_concentration_index_90d
risk_profile.description: Herfindahl index: sum of squared per-symbol shares of traded notional in the last 90 days.

risk_profile.name: lifetime_distinct_symbols_traded
risk_profile.description: Total unique instruments ever traded (specialist vs explorer)

platform_health.name: client_id
platform_health.description: Alphanumeric synthetic client identifier; join metric tables on this column.

platform_health.name: total_session_expirations_30d
platform_health.description: Global count of session expirations due to token expiry

platform_health.name: most_traded_instrument_by_volume_30d
platform_health.description: Single instrument with highest trading volume across all users

platform_health.name: instrument_with_largest_trader_increase
platform_health.description: Instrument with largest increase in unique traders (trending)

platform_health.name: client_error_rate_30d
platform_health.description: Percentage of API requests resulting in 4xx client errors Stored as a fraction (0–1); multiply by 100 for percentage display.

platform_health.name: avg_api_response_time_ms_30d
platform_health.description: Average server response time for user's API requests

platform_health.name: avg_time_to_fill_seconds_30d
platform_health.description: Average time from order placement to trade execution

platform_health.name: error_to_trade_ratio_30d
platform_health.description: Ratio of client-side errors to executed trades

platform_health.name: avg_time_to_load_dashboard_ms
platform_health.description: Average response time for dashboard API calls

platform_health.name: order_rejection_rate_30d
platform_health.description: Percentage of orders explicitly rejected by system Stored as a fraction (0–1); multiply by 100 for percentage display.

platform_health.name: orders_not_traded_ratio_30d
platform_health.description: Ratio of orders never filled (cancelled/rejected) to total orders

platform_health.name: avg_order_life_to_cancel_minutes
platform_health.description: Average time cancelled orders survived before cancellation

platform_health.name: avg_trade_fill_ratio_90d
platform_health.description: Mean filled quantity / requested quantity over orders in the last 90 days, including unfilled orders.

platform_health.name: is_high_volume_cancelled_flag
platform_health.description: Flag (1/0) if user has high notional value of cancelled orders (top 5%)

market_health.name: client_id
market_health.description: Alphanumeric synthetic client identifier; join metric tables on this column.

market_health.name: most_cancelled_instrument_30d
market_health.description: Instrument with highest cancellation count (volatility/friction indicator)

market_health.name: most_profitable_instrument_all_users_90d
market_health.description: Instrument generating highest total positive P&L across all users
